name: Unigardens
about:
UniGardens Canberra is a boutique student accommodation in Canberra. It offers a range of stylish and comfortable apartments and rooms, state-of-the-art amenities, and convenient proximity to the Australian National University and popular attractions, providing students with an exceptional living experience. There is a bus stop right in front of the UniGardens student accommodation, and markets, shopping centres, cinemas, restaurants, bars, and cafes are all within walking distance.
 
Features: 
UniGardens student accommodation offers three levels of boutique self-contained budget student accommodation comprising furnished studios in various configurations, fully furnished 1-bedroom and 2-bedroom apartments of the highest calibre in design and comfort, totalling 75 flats, where each unit's bedroom and sleeping area can accommodate either two single beds or one king-size bed. These apartments and rooms can be shared by several students or rented privately by one person. Additional amenities include a shared basement laundry room with washing machines, dryers, and irons and common areas such as a fully equipped study room with a free-for-all exchange-based library, billiard game table, gym, table tennis, and a TV lounge area. The Australian-style barbecue (BBQ) area is organized on the ground floor terrace for all students and tenants living in UniGardens to enjoy, while all standard area doors, apartments, and bedrooms are accessible only by a resident's personalised security card, and 24/7 CCTV security cameras recording and monitoring entrances and activity in the building's common areas.
 
Location and What's Hot?
UniGardens Canberra is conveniently located in a quiet area, just a minute's walk away from Uni of Canberra (UC), the Australian Institute of Sport, the Canberra Institute of Technology, and Calvary Hospital. Not only that, but UniGardens also offers proximity to popular attractions such as Canberra Tracks - Gossan Hill, Gossan Hill Nature Reserve Park, and Lake Ginninderra, all within walking distance. The lively area of Belconnen further enhances the experience with options for the active lifestyle, including nearby shopping options like Coles Jamison and Jamison Plaza, as well as Shell Coles Express, while also satisfying culinary cravings with renowned eateries such as Pizza Artigiana, Turkish Pide House, and Subway.
 
Transport:
Transport accessibility is an important consideration for students living near UniGardens student accommodation in Canberra. The area offers a variety of transport options, including train, bus and light rail.
 
Train: Canberra's railway station is only about a 15-minute walk from UniGardens flats. Train services connect the city centre as well as the surrounding area with a frequency of every 30 minutes, with exact journey times varying depending on the destination.
 
Bus: Buses are the main mode of transport connecting UniGardens to major universities such as the Australian National University and the University of Canberra. A number of bus routes pass through the flats, usually departing every 10 to 15 minutes. The Australian National University can be reached directly on line 1, while the University of Canberra can be reached on line 3, which is about a 30-minute journey.
 
Light Rail: The light rail system provides easy access to Canberra with the nearest light rail station within walking distance of the flats.
